# Mitchell & Crosby Family Dentistry - Full Clinical & Practice Profile

Mitchell & Crosby Family Dentistry has proudly served Casa Grande and the greater Pinal County, Arizona community for over seven decades. Founded in 1953 by Dr. Franklin Mitchell, DDS, the practice continues its legacy of clinical excellence, technological leadership, and compassionate, relationship-driven patient care.

## Clinical Leadership
- **Dr. Jeffrey Mitchell, DDS**: A native of Casa Grande, Dr. Mitchell has practiced dentistry for over 30 years. He graduated with his Doctor of Dental Surgery degree in 1989 and completed specialized postgraduate training in CEREC 3D CAD/CAM digital restorative dentistry, implantology, and advanced aesthetic smile makeovers.
- **Dr. David Crosby, DMD**: Graduated with honors from Midwestern University College of Dental Medicine. Dr. Crosby specializes in restorative treatments, complex crown-and-bridge procedures, precision endodontics, and modern surgical techniques.
- **Dr. Franklin Mitchell, DDS (Founder)**: Established the practice in 1953 on Olive Ave, building the foundational principles of integrity, community trust, and patient-first dentistry.

## Full Catalog of Treatments & Procedures

### 1. CEREC Same Day Ceramic Crowns
Using in-office 3D intraoral optical scanning and CAD/CAM robotic milling, patients receive permanent, precision-fitted ceramic crowns in a single visit lasting under 2 hours. Eliminates gag-inducing putty impressions, temporary crowns that dislodge, and multi-week waiting periods.

### 2. Dental Implants & Restorations
Titanium implant posts surgically placed to replace root structures of missing teeth, topped with custom porcelain crowns. Prevents bone loss, preserves facial profile, and functions identically to natural tooth dentition.

### 3. Cosmetic Porcelain Veneers
Handcrafted wafer-thin dental porcelain shells bonded to the facial surface of anterior teeth to correct discoloration, gaps, worn enamel, minor misalignment, or chipped teeth.

### 4. Omnichroma Composite Restorations
Smart shade-matching composite fillings that seamlessly blend with adjacent enamel without artificial discoloration. 100% BPA-free and mercury-free resin.

### 5. Full & Partial Dentures / Implant-Supported Overdentures
Custom prosthetics crafted to restore full dental arches with balanced occlusion, natural aesthetics, and stable retention.

### 6. Professional Teeth Whitening
High-concentration, enamel-safe carbamide and hydrogen peroxide formulations designed to lift deep extrinsic and intrinsic stains caused by coffee, tea, tobacco, and aging.

### 7. Emergency Dental Care
Immediate pain relief, infection management, root canal therapy, and emergency tooth re-cementation for trauma, acute toothaches, and broken teeth.

### 8. Preventative Cleanings & Periodontal Maintenance
Comprehensive prophylaxis, ultrasonic scaling, digital bitewing and panoramic radiography, oral cancer screenings, and fluoride treatments.
